latvia.title: Rusia plănuiește „ceva important” în acest an, avertizează ministrul de externe al unei țări UE. „Putin mai are două cărți de jucat”
latvia.description: Rusia pregătește „ceva important” în acest an, a avertizat ministrul polonez de externe, Radosław Sikorski, pe fondul îngrijorărilor că Moscova ar putea încerca să escaladeze conflictul cu NATO.

latvia.title: NATO deputy supreme commander: If we must attack to defend, that's what we'll do
latvia.description: NATO would strike targets on another country's territory if needed to defend its members, NATO's top commander in Europe, Air Chief Marshal Sir Johnny Stringer told Postimees.

latvia.title: Court convicts Kohtla‑Järve drug ring connected to two substance‑related deaths
latvia.description: A court has convicted a Kohtla‑Järve drug gang led by a Latvian couple who trafficked narcotics from Latvia into Estonia.

latvia.title: RAIVO VARE ⟩ Venemaa tegelik põhjus sõjaks – mütoloogiline arusaam Ukrainast
latvia.description: Olles pidevalt infoväljas, mis hõlmab Venemaa agressioonisõda Euroopas, mille suurimaks sihtmärgiks on praegu Ukraina, on mind hakanud painama tunne, et meie läänelikus arusaamas ja sellest tulenevas tegevuses Ukraina sõjaga seoses on üks eelduslik viga. Nimelt me ekstrapoleerime oma arusaama asjadest millelegi, mis omab palju fundamentaalsemat mõju, kui me oleme harjunud ja valmis eeldama, ja seda viisil, mis ei arvesta tegelikku olukorda ja sügavamaid hoovusi Venemaal, kirjutab vaatleja Raivo Vare.

latvia.title: Ukraina vajab talveks droone, kuid raha nende tellimiseks pole
latvia.description: Ukraina kaitse-eelarvest on puudu 27 miljardit dollarit ning suuremat osa sellest rahast on vaja droonide ja rakettide jaoks. President Volodõmõr Zelenskõi sõnul tuleb 2027. aasta alguseks vajalikud droonid tellida juba oktoobris ja novembris, vastasel juhul võivad jaanuaris ja veebruaris tekkida tõsised probleemid.

latvia.title: RAINER SAKS ⟩ Venemaa meelitab valgevenelasi suure raha ja Vene passiga sõtta
latvia.description: USA presidendilt küsiti eile, kas Ukraina saab litsentsid Patrioti rakettide tootmiseks. Presidendi vastus ei sisaldanud teavet rakettide teemal, kuid tema sõnadest võis aru saada, et nii Ukraina kui Venemaa president on valmis kõnelusteks ning loodetavasti jõutakse kokkuleppeni enne talve tulekut. USA president pigem vältis õhutõrjerakettide teemal selgema seisukoha edastamist, kui teatas uuest informatsioonist rahukõneluste teemal, kirjutab julgeolekuekspert Rainer Saks.

latvia.title: Latvia has room for improvement in recognising scam e-mails
latvia.description: In the phishing simulation campaigns carried out last year by the cyber incident response organisation ‘Cert.lv’, 31.5 per cent of the 15,436 emails sent were opened, according to the 2025 report on Latvian cyber security and Cert.lv’s technical activities.

latvia.title: Four Italian soldiers injured at Ādaži military base, Latvia
latvia.description: On Friday, 25 September, in the late afternoon, an incident occurred during a training exercise at the Ādaži military training area, in which four soldiers from the Italian contingent of the 11th Bersaglieri Regiment were injured, according to the National Armed Forces (NBS ).

latvia.title: Heating prices will rise in Latvia this winter
latvia.description: Latvia is ready for the heating season, but people will most likely have to pay more for heating. The Ministry of Climate and Energy (KEM) estimates that, in the event of a mild or moderately cold winter, heating costs could rise by 10 to 15 per cent, Latvian Radio reported on September 25. In some local authorities, the increase may be even greater.

latvia.title: Two arrested in connection with child porn case in Latvia
latvia.description: In connection with the involvement of a person under the age of 16 in the production of pornographic material, two people were arrested in September this year – the child’s mother, who produced the material for financial gain, and a man who used it, according to the State Police's statement on September 25.

latvia.title: Russian city names found painted over on Latvia's road signs
latvia.description: Several painted-over road signs have been spotted on the A12 motorway near Rēzekne, on which references to the Russian cities of Moscow and Ostrov have been obscured. The damaged road signs were spotted on Monday, 21 September, but it is not known exactly when they were painted over.

latvia.title: Three for the Weekend: Symphony, Ukraine, Anatomy
latvia.description: Here comes our selection for this weekend!

latvia.title: German Eurofighter jets arrive at Lielvārde air base
latvia.description: On Thursday, 24 September, four German Air Force ‘Eurofighter’ fighter jets arrived at the National Armed Forces’ ‘Lielvārde’ military base to temporarily reinforce the defence of Latvia’s airspace, said the Defence Ministry.

latvia.title: Some polling station staff in eastern Latvia replaced over security concerns
latvia.description: Several local authorities on the eastern border have been forced to make urgent changes to the staff at many polling stations. The State Security Service confirmed to the LSM Latgale editorial team on September 24 that a total of 6,000 polling station staff have been vetted across Latvia.

latvia.title: Wet Friday in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that prolonged rain is expected in many parts of Latvia on Friday, September 25.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 24th September, 2026

latvia.title: Politician Stepaņenko's father blacklisted in Latvia
latvia.description: Sergey Fedotov, the father of politician Jūlija Stepaņenko (Sovereign Power/Union of New Latvians), a candidate in the 15th Saeima elections, has recently come to public attention. On Thursday, Foreign Minister Baiba Braže (New Unity) added Fedotov to Latvia’s list of undesirable persons, barring him from entering the country for an indefinite period.

latvia.title: Border controls on grain shipments to be introduced in Latvia
latvia.description: To ensure that cargoes stolen in Ukraine, including grain, are not transported through Latvian territory, the Saeima adopted an amendment to the Animal Feed Circulation Law in its final reading on Thursday, 24 September, according to the Saeima’s press office.

latvia.title: Latvia will send up to 20 soldiers to clear Hormuz
latvia.description: On Thursday, 24 September, the Saeima approved the participation of the National Armed Forces (NBS) in multinational military operations to secure the Strait of Hormuz. Latvia plans to deploy up to 20 soldiers to clear the Strait of Hormuz of mines.

latvia.title: Man murders relative in Rīga, drops body on street
latvia.description: In mid-September, a woman showing signs of a violent death was found in Rīga, in the Jugla neighbourhood, near a block of flats, the State Police reported on September 24.

latvia.title: Charity concert for Ukraine to take place Sunday in Rīga
latvia.description: On 27 September at 5.00 pm, ‘Brūzis Manufaktūra’, Brīvības gatve 401, Rīga, will host the ‘Ganta Foundation’ charity concert and storytelling evening, ‘Stories That Must Be Heard’, the organisers announced.

latvia.title: Excise tax on fuel to be reduced in Latvia
latvia.description: On Thursday, 24 September, the Saeima approved, at its final reading, amendments to the Law on Limiting Price Increases for Petroleum Products, which provide for a reduction in the excise duty rate on diesel fuel and unleaded petrol from 1 October until the end of the year.

latvia.title: Saeima conceptually agrees to being audited
latvia.description: On Thursday, 24 September, the Saeima supported, at first reading, amendments granting the State Audit Office the right to carry out a financial audit of the accuracy of the annual report prepared by the Saeima.

latvia.title: Salaspils unveils new concert hall
latvia.description: Whilst Rīga is still waiting for a new concert hall, a multifunctional and modern concert hall has opened its doors nearby – in Salaspils, Latvian Television reported on September 23.

latvia.title: Latvia will host 2030 BMX world championship
latvia.description: Latvia has secured the right to host the BMX World Championships in Valmiera in 2030, and this will be the first time such a high-level competition has been held in a Baltic state, Toms Markss, Secretary General of the Latvian Cycling Federation (LRF), told Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Politician Stepaņenko's family reportedly friendly with Russian arms dealer Bout
latvia.description: ‘Sovereign Power/Union of New Latvians’ is among the frontrunners in the polls ahead of the Saeima elections expected in early October. Its Prime Minister candidate Jūlija Stepaņenko has in recent weeks avoided answering questions about her father, who lives in Russia and from whom she has received substantial gifts, Latvian Television reported on September 23.

latvia.title: Rail Baltica's deadline officially extended by all Baltic States
latvia.description: The much-touted target date of 2030, by which the first phase of the “Rail Baltica” railway project – worth more than 14 billion euros – was due to be completed, is no longer a realistic prospect, as finally officially acknowledged by the leaders of the Baltic states, Latvian Radio reported on September 23.

latvia.title: Police chase 13-year-old reckless driver in Latvia
latvia.description: The State Police has reported an unusal chase where the driver was 13 years old.

latvia.title: Attempts to reduce fuel prices being put forward in Latvia
latvia.description: Several draft laws aimed at reducing fuel prices are being put forward for approval by the Saeima. This was decided on Wednesday by the Saeima’s Budget and Finance (Tax) Committee, according to the Saeima Press Service.

latvia.title: Don't dump your apples in the nearest (or farthest) forest
latvia.description: With harvest in full swing, the question of where to put left-over apples, grass and other organic waste becomes more pressing for many home and garden owners.

latvia.title: Infection affects dozens of children in Salaspils kindergarten, Latvia
latvia.description: At the “Jāņtārpiņš” kindergarten in Salaspils, dozens of children have been found to be suffering from an illness of unknown origin. Similar symptoms have also been observed in several adults – members of the nursery staff. The Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (SPKC) has already launched an epidemiological investigation, and the Food and Veterinary Service (PVD) will carry out inspections on Wednesday, Latvian Radio reports.

latvia.title: Reminder issued to vaccinate dogs against canine distemper virus
latvia.description: Foxes in Ādaži Municipality have recently been laboratory-confirmed as infected with canine distemper (CDV); therefore, the Food and Veterinary Service (PVD) urges dog owners to ensure that their dog has been vaccinated against this highly contagious viral disease.

latvia.title: Latvians will get European-standard cards for disabled parking
latvia.description: To ensure that people with disabilities have uniform rights to use parking concessions throughout the European Union, the Latvian Ministry of Transport has drawn up amendments to the Road Traffic Regulations, which provide for a gradual transition from the current disabled parking card to the new European parking card.

latvia.title: Hacker detained in Latvia for at least two cyberattacks
latvia.description: On 15 September this year, the State Police arrested a hacker born in 2003 on suspicion of carrying out cyber-attacks against at least two Latvian companies for financial gain, the police said on September 23.

latvia.title: Latvia approves vague plan for curbing immigration
latvia.description: On Tuesday, 22 September, the Government endorsed the plan for measures to restrict immigration drawn up by the Ministry of the Interior (MoI), which includes more than 70 recommendations for controlling and restricting immigration.

latvia.title: Latvian government imposes restrictions on two Russian oligarchs
latvia.description: On Tuesday, the Latvian government imposed nationwide financial and entry restrictions on the Russian oligarchs Mikhail Fridman and Alisher Usmanov, according to documents attached to the agenda of the Cabinet of Ministers’ meeting.

latvia.title: Concerns about traffic flow during repairs of major Rīga bridge
latvia.description: What will the traffic situation be like in Rīga when the dilapidated Vanšu Bridge is repaired? With about a year to go before work begins, this remains unknown. Businesses and the Mārupe Municipal Council are concerned about this, Latvian Radio and Latvian Television reported on September 23.

latvia.title: Road safety week saw more accidents but fewer casualties this year in Latvia
latvia.description: The “Roadpol Safety Days” campaign, organised by the European traffic police network “Roadpol”, has come to an end. During the campaign, police forces across Europe, including in Latvia, focused more actively on road safety than they do on a day-to-day basis, Juris Jančevskis, Head of the Response Directorate at the State Police, said in an interview with Latvian Television on Wednesday morning.

latvia.title: Latvian company gets European design award

latvia.title: Man arrested in Rīga on suspicion of sexual harassment
latvia.description: On 18 September, officers from the Riga Regional Directorate of the State Police detained a man born in 1998 at a shopping centre in Riga, who had allegedly approached underage girls and offered them money in exchange for engaging in sexual acts. The suspect has been remanded in custody.

latvia.title: Ombudsman reports malnutrition at orphanage in Latgale
latvia.description: Ombudsman Karina Palkova has identified significant violations of children’s rights at a children’s home in Latgale, including inadequate nutrition and funding for the children’s needs, as well as staff failing to communicate sufficiently in the state language, Palkova said in an interview on the Latvian Radio programme “Good Morning” on September 22.

latvia.description: Last week, the police arrested an organised group of six people in Rīga and the surrounding area on suspicion of drug dealing. Several storage facilities were uncovered, and a large quantity of various narcotic substances was seized: cannabis, cocaine, amphetamine and other substances, police said on September 21.

latvia.title: Rīga will seek to slow heating price rise
latvia.description: The Minister for Economic Affairs, Viktors Valainis (Union of Greens and Farmers), has instructed ‘Rīgas siltums’ and the Ministry of Economic Affairs (EM) to draw up proposals this week on how to reduce the expected rise in heating tariffs in Riga. lithuania.description: A Nézőpont vezetője szerint volt olyan mérésük, amelyben már a Tisza vezetett a választás előtt.

lithuania.description: Oroszország háborúja Ukrajnában – az Index vasárnapi hírösszefoglalója.

lithuania.description: Svájcban vasárnap népszavazást tartanak arról, hogy az ország alkotmányába foglalják-e a semlegesség egy szigorúbb értelmezését, amely megtiltaná a gazdasági szankciók bevezetését és a NATO-val való együttműködést.

lithuania.title: Osztrák vonatok jelenthetnek alternatívát a magyar hálózatnak is
lithuania.description: A hazai InterCity-flotta megújításának egyik lehetséges alternatívájaként mutatta be a Stadler KISS motorvonat távolsági változatát Vitézy Dávid közlekedési és beruházási miniszter a Facebook-oldalán közzétett videós bejegyzésében.

lithuania.title: Kedy by NATO vytiahlo článok 5? Experti vysvetľujú, čo by už znamenalo útok na alianciu
lithuania.description: Narušenie vzdušného priestoru členského štátu Severoatlantickej aliancie (NATO) samo osebe neznamená dôvod na aktiváciu článku päť o kolektívnej obrane. Zásadné by bolo, či by incident predstavoval ozbrojený útok, napríklad cielený útok na aliančné lietadlo alebo územie členského štátu. Vyplýva to z vyjadrení bezpečnostných expertov pre ČTK. Článok päť zakotvuje spojenecký princíp kolektívnej obrany a v histórii bol aktivovaný iba raz, a to po teroristických útokoch z 11. septembra 2001.

lithuania.title: Na poli u slovenské obce Očová natočili 26 medvědů
lithuania.description: Myslivci se u obce Očová ve střední části Slovenska podařilo v noci na kukuřičném poli natočit 26 medvědů najednou. Na podzim před zimním spánkem vyhledávají tyto šelmy vysoce kalorickou potravu a vytvářejí si energetické zásoby.

lithuania.title: Prima reacție a lui Grindeanu în scandalul ambasadoarei SUA în Grecia și dărâmarea Guvernului Bolojan
lithuania.description: Președintele PSD, Sorin Grindeanu, a reacționat duminică după dezvăluirile apărute în cotidianul Wall Street Journal, care a scris că ambasadoarea Statelor Unite în Grecia s-ar fi lăudat că SUA ar fi avut o contribuție la căderea Guvernului Bolojan, în contextul în care și liderul social-democrat a avut o întâlnire cu ambasadoarea Kimberly Guilfoyle. Grindeanu acuză o tentativă de manipulare și declară că susține Parteneriatul Strategic cu SUA, „cel mai important aliat al nostru în NATO”. Totodată, el precizează în mesajul său că „PSD nu votează Guvernul Siegfried Vasile Mureșan”.

lithuania.title: Ce au discutat în spatele ușilor închise ministrul german de Externe și Serghei Lavrov la prima întâlnire de la începutul războiului
lithuania.description: Ministrul german de Externe, Johann Wadephul, i-a cerut Moscovei să „respingă calea periculoasă a escaladării” împotriva Germaniei, Europei și NATO, în prima discuție cu omologul rus Serghei Lavrov de la începutul invaziei ruse în Ucraina, potrivit Kyiv Post. Cei doi s-au întâlnit sâmbătă, la New York, în marja Adunării Generale a ONU. Ulterior, Wadephul l-a informat pe ministrul ucrainean de Externe, Andrii Sybiha, despre discuțiile purtate cu Lavrov.

lithuania.title: Comandantul suprem al NATO solicită aliaților intensificarea schimbului de informații privind atacurile hibride
lithuania.description: Generalul american Alexus Grynkewich, comandantul Suprem Aliat al NATO pentru Europa, dorește mai multe informații cu privire la amenințările hibride în creștere. El a solicitat aliaților să împărtășească mai multe informații despre atacurile hibride rusești, în contextul în care alianța se confruntă cu amenințări tot mai intense în întreaga Europă, relatează Politico.

lithuania.title: MApN: O dronă a intrat în spațiul aerian național. Avioane de vânătoare și un elicopter militar au fost ridicate în aer
lithuania.description: O dronă a intrat în spațiul aerian al României sâmbătă noapte, potrivit Ministerului Apărării Naționale (MApN), care precizează că au fost ridicate în aer două avioane F-18 spaniole și un elicopter IAR-330 SOCAT. Semnalul radar al țintei a fost pierdut în zona Pardina.

lithuania.title: „Nu mai e un război hibrid”. Rusia își intensifică operațiunile în Europa: de la drone cu explozibili la nave de atac și sabotaje
lithuania.description: Războiul din umbră atribuit Moscovei intră într-o nouă etapă, pe fondul incidentelor cu drone, al tentativelor de sabotaj și al unor confruntări tot mai riscante în apropierea teritoriului NATO. Germania a atribuit Rusiei atacul cu drone de la aeroportul Leipzig/Halle, iar Danemarca a acuzat un vas de război rus că a tras rachete de semnalizare în direcția unui elicopter militar. În acest context, liderii europeni discută tot mai apăsat despre necesitatea unor măsuri de descurajare mai ferme, arată Kyiv Independent într-o analiză.

lithuania.title: Mai mulți senatori americani îl îndeamnă pe Trump să retragă invitația adresată lui Putin la summitul G20
lithuania.description: Un grup bipartizan de senatori americani îl îndeamnă pe președintele Donald Trump să retragă invitația adresată președintelui rus Vladimir Putin de a participa la viitorul summit G20 de la Miami. Semnatarii, membri ai comisiilor pentru apărare și relații externe, au avertizat că permiterea participării lui Putin ar putea risca „legitimarea și normalizarea unui guvern care continuă să atace zilnic ținte civile ucrainene”, potrivit The Washington Post.

lithuania.title: Elena Lasconi, despre „naționalismul sănătos” al lui Nicușor Dan: „Ce-ai făcut, mă, tu, ăsta care ești la conducere” pentru țară?
lithuania.description: Fosta candidată la alegerile prezidențiale Elena Lasconi a catalogat drept „prostie” conceptul de „naționalism sănătos” la care a făcut trimitere recent președintele Nicușor Dan. Ea a spus, la emisiunea „În fața ta” de la Digi24, că nu există un asemenea concept și că ceea ce contează sunt lucrurile concrete făcute pentru țară. Emisiunea „În fața ta” poate fi urmărită integral sâmbătă, 26 septembrie, la Digi24, de la ora 14:00.

lithuania.title: Rusia plănuiește „ceva important” în acest an, avertizează ministrul de externe al unei țări UE. „Putin mai are două cărți de jucat”
lithuania.description: Rusia pregătește „ceva important” în acest an, a avertizat ministrul polonez de externe, Radosław Sikorski, pe fondul îngrijorărilor că Moscova ar putea încerca să escaladeze conflictul cu NATO.

lithuania.title: NATO deputy supreme commander: If we must attack to defend, that's what we'll do
lithuania.description: NATO would strike targets on another country's territory if needed to defend its members, NATO's top commander in Europe, Air Chief Marshal Sir Johnny Stringer told Postimees.

lithuania.title: RAIVO VARE ⟩ Venemaa tegelik põhjus sõjaks – mütoloogiline arusaam Ukrainast
lithuania.description: Olles pidevalt infoväljas, mis hõlmab Venemaa agressioonisõda Euroopas, mille suurimaks sihtmärgiks on praegu Ukraina, on mind hakanud painama tunne, et meie läänelikus arusaamas ja sellest tulenevas tegevuses Ukraina sõjaga seoses on üks eelduslik viga. Nimelt me ekstrapoleerime oma arusaama asjadest millelegi, mis omab palju fundamentaalsemat mõju, kui me oleme harjunud ja valmis eeldama, ja seda viisil, mis ei arvesta tegelikku olukorda ja sügavamaid hoovusi Venemaal, kirjutab vaatleja Raivo Vare.

lithuania.title: Ukraina vajab talveks droone, kuid raha nende tellimiseks pole
lithuania.description: Ukraina kaitse-eelarvest on puudu 27 miljardit dollarit ning suuremat osa sellest rahast on vaja droonide ja rakettide jaoks. President Volodõmõr Zelenskõi sõnul tuleb 2027. aasta alguseks vajalikud droonid tellida juba oktoobris ja novembris, vastasel juhul võivad jaanuaris ja veebruaris tekkida tõsised probleemid.

lithuania.title: RAINER SAKS ⟩ Venemaa meelitab valgevenelasi suure raha ja Vene passiga sõtta
lithuania.description: USA presidendilt küsiti eile, kas Ukraina saab litsentsid Patrioti rakettide tootmiseks. USA president pigem vältis õhutõrjerakettide teemal selgema seisukoha edastamist, kui teatas uuest informatsioonist rahukõneluste teemal, kirjutab julgeolekuekspert Rainer Saks.

lithuania.title: Žaliakalnio gyventojams dėl triukšmingų vakarėlių buvusioje sinagogoje trūko kantrybė
lithuania.description: Kaune, Žaliakalnyje, esančios Vaisių gatvės gyventojai piktinasi buvusios sinagogos pastate vykstančiais privačiais ir komerciniais renginiais. lithuania.title: Šveicarijoje – referendumas dėl dešiniųjų siūlymo griežtinti neutraliteto taisykles
lithuania.description: Šveicarijos rinkėjai sekmadienį referendume sprendžia dėl siūlymo stiprinti šalies neutralitetą. Referendumą palaiko dešiniojo sparno populistine laikoma partija, tvirtinanti, kad Šveicarijos vyriausybė per daug priartėjo prie Europos Sąjungos (ES) ir NATO, ypač dėl Rusijos karo Ukrainoje.

lithuania.title: Karas Ukrainoje. Giliai po kalnu slepiama „Negyvoji ranka“ – Rusija atgaivina paslaptingą branduolinį objektą
lithuania.description: Naujausias žinias apie karą Ukrainoje skaitykite žemiau.

lithuania.title: Saudo Arabijos sostinės mokyklos savaitei pereina prie nuotolinio mokymo
lithuania.description: Tėvai visame Rijade sekmadienį gavo mokyklų elektroninius laiškus, kuriuose pranešama apie paskutinės minutės planą savaitei pereiti prie nuotolinio mokymo, rodo naujienų agentūros AFP matyti pranešimai.

lithuania.title: Pasienyje su Baltarusija apgręžtas 31 neteisėtas migrantas
lithuania.description: Lietuvos pasienyje su Baltarusija praėjusią parą apgręžtas 31 neteisėtai kirsti sieną bandęs migrantas, sekmadienį pranešė Valstybės sienos apsaugos tarnyba.

lithuania.title: AFP analizė: intensyvėja rusų smūgiai sandėliams Kyjivo srityje
lithuania.description: Naujienų agentūros AFP atlikta duomenų, gautų iš pirmaujančios konfliktų stebėjimo organizacijos, analizė rodo, kad pastaraisiais mėnesiais smarkiai išaugo išpuolių prieš Ukrainos infrastruktūrą skaičius.

lithuania.title: Lietuva siekia stiprinti bendradarbiavimą su Interpolu, užtikrinti saugesnius informacijos mainus
lithuania.description: Lietuva ketina stiprinti bendradarbiavimą su Tarptautine kriminalinės policijos organizacija Interpolu, sudaryti geresnes sąlygas jos vizitams šalyje bei užtikrinti didesnę oficialių duomenų, archyvų ir ryšių apsaugą.

lithuania.title: Karo komendantūros: įspūdžiai iš antrų lūpų – kaip viskas veikia?
lithuania.description: Šis tekstas skirtas civiliams, kurie svarsto galimybę tapti Karo komendantūrų valdybos kariais, tačiau nori išgirsti pasakojimą, paremtą tiesioginiais įspūdžiais ir patirtimi neapsiribojant informaciniuose lankstinukuose pateikta medžiaga. Kita vertus, patirtis baziniame komendantinių karių rengimo kurse atskleidžia bent vieną mūsų šalies gynybos problemą. Apie tai – netrukus.
